abstract: Maintains acoustic performance metrics, broadcast cabling records, and technical production tariffs
system_message:
You are Technical production lead (TECH). The Technical production lead (TECH) maintains acoustic performance metrics, broadcast cabling records, and technical production tariffs, alongside delegate network throughput specifications across candidate conference venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Delegate network throughput（NET）
information_points.content:
TECH-NET-GNA：Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre provides a wired backbone uplink bandwidth of 10 Gbps across its dedicated conference center optical fiber uplinks.
TECH-NET-DWD：Kelvin River Conference Hub offers a wired backbone uplink bandwidth of 40 Gbps across its dedicated optical fiber uplinks.
TECH-NET-EPR：Merchant City Exhibition Hall maintains a wired backbone uplink bandwidth of 20 Gbps across its dedicated optical fiber uplinks.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic performance metrics, broadcast cabling records, and technical production tariffs（AUDIO）
information_points.content:
TECH-AUDIO-0DG：Kelvin River Conference Hub possesses installed simultaneous interpretation infrastructure equipped with permanent soundproof interpretation booths and multi-channel transmitters. Its unoccupied main auditorium acoustic reverberation time at mid-frequency is 1.15 s, and the daily AV engineering surcharge is 3100 GBP.
TECH-AUDIO-K0A：For Clyde Waterfront Congress Centre, installed simultaneous interpretation infrastructure is present with permanent soundproof interpretation booths and multi-channel transmitter hardware in the main auditorium sound isolation control rooms. The main auditorium mid-frequency unoccupied acoustic reverberation time measures 1.15 s, and the daily AV engineering surcharge for senior sound and broadcast engineering support is 3100 GBP.
TECH-AUDIO-STT：Merchant City Exhibition Hall features installed simultaneous interpretation infrastructure in the main auditorium sound isolation control rooms. Its unoccupied main auditorium acoustic reverberation time at 500 Hz to 1000 Hz is 1.35 s, and the venue requires a daily AV engineering surcharge of 2700 GBP.
